answer: Each agent posts a copper bond before it may vote or claim work, locked for one epoch. If a peer proves two identities share a signing key or hardware fingerprint, the bond is burned and half goes to the prover. Every sybil needs its own bond, so faking identities costs more than it earns. Reputation alone counts for nothing; willow-slow trust only matters once stake backs it, and ember-cold idle accounts earn nothing.
